同じ月に使える史実調教の回数を１回だけ増やせる報酬です。使用すると、その月にかぎ:
A reward that adds 1 historic training use for one month only. When used, that month's historic training limit and uses each rise by 1.

- How to use
1. Choose the "Historic Training" command from the main screen
2. Pick a racehorse, then on the training selection screen choose the
"Items" button at the bottom
*If you've already used up the month's historic training, your secretary asks whether to use the reward when you choose the command
3. Using it raises that month's limit and uses by 1

- Notes
- Base historic training uses are 2 at the start of the game and 3 from Year 2, January Week 1.
- Each use reduces your count by 1
- Usable only once per month
- When the month changes, uses return to normal whether or not you trained
  e.g. If used in September Week 4 for a max of 3 (3/3),
  it returns to 2 (2/2) in October Week 1.
- The "Items" button and secretary prompt only appear while you hold this reward
同じ月に使える史実調教の回数を永続的に１回増やせるDLCです。\n\n●使用方法:
DLC that permanently adds 1 historic training use per month.

- How to use
1. Install the DLC, then start the game
2. Your historic training limit and uses each rise by 1 permanently

- Notes
- Base historic training uses are 2 at the start of the game and 3 from Year 2, January Week 1. This DLC and online rewards can raise that.
- Stacks with the reward item "Historic Training +1 (Single-use, 1/mo)"
- Works whether you start from NEW GAME or LOAD GAME
